The best long games on PS Plus

Some games are worth settling into for months. These are our ten favourite long games on PS Plus right now, each with a main story of 40 hours or more, from huge RPGs to strategy and sandbox games you can play forever. Each one says what kind of game it is and roughly how long it takes. The full list of long games follows.

What counts as long

A game counts as long here if HowLongToBeat's players take 40 hours or more on average to finish its main story. That's the time to see the credits at a normal pace, so doing everything will usually take far longer.

For games without a story ending, like strategy and sandbox games, it's the average time players put in. The full list includes every game on PS Plus with a 40-hour average or more.

1

Persona 5 Royal

JRPG · PS5 · Metascore 95 · 98% recommend on OpenCritic · about 101 h main story

By day you're a transfer student in Tokyo, juggling classes and friendships. By night you and your friends become the Phantom Thieves, stealing the hearts of corrupt adults. Every hour of it is stylish, and it has one of the best soundtracks in games.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

2

Crusader Kings III

Grand strategy · PS5 · Metascore 91 · about 77 h main story

You guide a medieval dynasty through marriages, plots, wars and murders, one ruler after another. It's a strategy game that tells stories, and no two playthroughs go the same way.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

3

Kingdom Come: Deliverance II

Realistic open-world RPG · PS5 · Metascore 89 · about 55 h main story

Henry, a blacksmith's son caught up in a civil war, makes his way across a lovingly recreated medieval Bohemia. It's a huge, realistic RPG where the world reacts to everything you do.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

4

Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth

Turn-based RPG · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 89 · about 57 h main story

Ichiban Kasuga heads to Hawaii in search of his long-lost mother, teaming up with Kazuma Kiryu along the way. It's big-hearted and very funny, with endless side stories and a full island-resort mode.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

5

Terraria

Sandbox adventure · PS4 · Metascore 81 · about 52 h main story

You dig, build, fight and explore a world made of blocks, in 2D. It starts simple and opens up into a huge game of crafting and boss fights, and it's even better with friends.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

6

Elite Dangerous

Space sim · PS4 · Metascore 80 · about 114 h main story

The whole Milky Way, at full scale, is yours to explore as a trader, explorer, miner or pilot for hire. It's slow, deep and endlessly calming once you're in the cockpit.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

7

Abiotic Factor

Co-op survival shooter · PS5 · Metascore 88 · about 44 h main story

An experiment goes wrong at an underground research lab, and a team of scientists has to survive what comes through. It's a funny co-op survival game with a lot to build and discover.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

8

Two Point Museum

Management sim · PS5 · Metascore 84 · about 47 h main story

You build and run museums, send experts on expeditions to dig up exhibits, and keep visitors (and ghosts) happy. It's charming and very easy to play for “one more expedition”.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

9

Coral Island

Farming sim · PS5 · Metascore 82 · about 56 h main story

You move to a tropical island to farm, fish, make friends and help restore its coral reef. It's a big, relaxed farming game with plenty to do every season.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

10

Assassin's Creed Valhalla

Open-world action RPG · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 80 · about 61 h main story

Eivor leads a Viking clan from Norway to settle in ninth-century England, raiding monasteries and building a home. It's enormous, and the settlement you grow along the way ties it together.

Questions

What's the longest game on PS Plus?

Elite Dangerous and Persona 5 Royal both take over 100 hours on average. Sandbox and strategy games like Crusader Kings III can go on as long as you like.

Are there long games that aren't RPGs?

Plenty. Crusader Kings III, Two Point Museum, Elite Dangerous and Terraria are strategy, management, space and sandbox games.

What's a good long game to play with friends?

Terraria and Abiotic Factor are both great in co-op. Our online co-op list has more.

Are there long classics on PS Plus Premium?

Yes. Harvest Moon: Back to Nature, Dark Cloud 2, The Legend of Dragoon and Grandia all take 40 hours or more.

What if I want something shorter?

Our short games list has games you can finish in under 10 hours.
